title: Logos 25 opening: firstborn of all creation; not creature
english: Twenty-fifth discourse. On “firstborn of all creation,” that the Son is not a creature.
Firstborn is balanced by Only-begotten so creatural ranking does not swallow the Son.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
